title: The Tenuous Venom Vendetta
story: In the shadowed streets of Gritville, a peculiar poisoning incident unveiled. On a stormy night, the local art gallery's lighting abruptly failed during the opening reception. Suddenly, a victim stumbled, clutching their chest. They gasped, 'I was... undercut!' before collapsing. The gallery was engulfed in darkness, with the murky scent of putrid moonflowers lingering.
crimeScene: The dimly lit Gritville Art Gallery filled with putrid moonflowers.
forensicClue: A single crimson mark on the deceased victim's wrist.
question: Who perpetrated the poisoning and how was the crime solved?
options: Option A (Elsie Moonflower - 'The Poisoned Painter' and motive).
Option B (Aiden Shadows - 'The Envious Gallerist' and motive)
Option C (Dr. Quinella Gloom - 'The Mysterious Botanist' and alibi)
Option D (Luna Foggy - 'The Illusive Collector' and opportunity)
